text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a seventh victory added to her
flawless record, all eyes are on
Mihono
Bourbon, if they weren't already.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As far as the media's concerned, she's
practically already won the
Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Admirer A
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon! Please, shake my hand!

text_block_list.name: Admirer B
text_block_list.text: I'd give anything for your autograph!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Same here! I'll take a big ol' ketchup
signature on this omelet
rice—and make it
cutesy!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I'm not sure I understand the
last part of your request, but
I'll do my
best.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Cutesy... cutesy...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that's it! Give it some steez!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding dong

text_block_list.name: School Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon, the student council
president would like to see you.
Please
report to her office.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: President Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Come in.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. You called, President Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We've had a veritable flood of
interview requests for you. I was
hoping
you'd acquiesce.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's no wonder, what with the undefeated
Triple Crown right before
your eyes.
Expectations are high.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But those expectations... Do you not feel
undue pressure from them?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No. Even if I did feel pressure, I would
simply convert it to strength.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good. Spoken like one who is prepared for
greatness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown requires much mental
fortitude to wear. I would see
you run as
your usual self.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...However,
I am cognizant of the fact that
achieving the Triple Crown
will be no easy
task.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower...
With each victory over her, I
seem to only grow more
aware of this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see. You mean to say she is your... Ah,
but what use is it putting it
into words?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My position does not allow me to play
favorites, but I do hope to see
a satisfying
end to this year's Classics.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I'll keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...That aside,
President. There's something
I want to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I can be of help,
I shall gladly answer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
When giving an autograph, how might one
make it more "cutesy"?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I'm afraid that goes beyond my area of
expertise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In my office, before practice.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Check it out! Guess who got Bourbon's
autograph?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: On omelet rice, of all things?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...The letters are cute.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
This is for you, Rice! I know you pack a
bigger appetite than you let
on! Dig in!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hweh?! You're not supposed to tell
people that!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Is it just me, or is everybody talking about Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Given her undefeated record, it's only
natural. You can't help but
wonder just
how far she'll go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We've nothing to fear.
Rice's abilities rival
hers, and that speaks for
itself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The shrinking gap between them with each
race is proof of that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Rice lost to Bourbon yet again in
her most recent race, it was
closer than in
the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Plus, her ambition is now fully focused on
winning against her rival.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh? Look at you, oozing with confidence!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's because training so much with you all
has made me into a stronger
runner.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I just can't wait to run against her
again.
It's all I can think about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's learned to feel excited about races
instead of anxious. That's
how you know
she's grown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing real progress in her repeated runs
against Bourbon must have
given her
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Let's kick off today's training!
First up, three laps around the
island of
Shikoku!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That's easily over 3,000 kilometers!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even as expectations for her rival pile
high, Rice Shower's fighting
spirit burns all
the brighter.
